description: This file contains plotting functions for PySpark DataFrames using Plotly, including pie charts, box plots, KDE plots, and histograms, with custom processing for columns and error handling.

classes.name: PySparkPlotAccessor
classes.description: Accessor class for plotting data in PySpark DataFrames.

classes.name: PySparkBoxPlotBase
classes.description: Base class for computing box plot statistics.

classes.name: PySparkKdePlotBase
classes.description: Base class for KDE plot computations.

classes.name: PySparkHistogramPlotBase
classes.description: Base class for histogram binning and count computations.

methods.name: plot_pyspark
methods.description: Main function to generate different plot types based on 'kind' parameter.

methods.name: plot_pie
methods.description: Creates a pie chart from a DataFrame, with support for subplots.

methods.name: plot_box
methods.description: Creates a box plot from a DataFrame with options for whiskers and notched boxes.

methods.name: plot_kde
methods.description: Generates a KDE plot for DataFrame columns.

methods.name: plot_histogram
methods.description: Creates a histogram from DataFrame data with binning options.

methods.name: process_column_param
methods.description: Processes and validates column parameters for plotting, ensuring numeric types.
